description: This file defines data model classes for nurse profiles, including CredentialFile and NurseProfile, used to represent nurse information and credentials within the healthcare application.

classes.name: CredentialFile
classes.description: Represents a credential document associated with a nurse, including properties such as id, filename, URL, and verification status.

classes.name: NurseProfile
classes.description: Models a nurse's profile, including personal details, skills, credentials, and an average rating.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the NurseProfile instance with optional modifications to specified fields.
